test.create_query: CREATE TABLE nullable_stats (counter_id Int32, user_id Nullable(Int64), width Nullable(Int16), engine_id Nullable(Int16), amount Nullable(Decimal64(2))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY counter_id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = 'basic'
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO nullable_stats SELECT number % 10000, if(number % 7 = 0, NULL, intHash64(number)), if(number % 11 = 0, NULL, number % 2000), if(number % 5 = 0, number % 30, NULL), if(number % 13 = 0, NULL, number / 100) FROM numbers_mt(50000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(engine_id), count(engine_id), avg(width) FROM nullable_stats
